title: Grand Prismatic Spring
description: This rainbow is real, and it is hot enough to burn you. Grand Prismatic Spring in Yellowstone is 110 meters wide and its colors are alive. Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Jim Peaco / National Park Service, Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This rainbow is real, and it is hot enough to burn you.
It is Grand Prismatic, the largest hot spring in Yellowstone.
It is one hundred ten meters wide and fifty meters deep.
The water comes up at seventy degrees Celsius.
The blue middle is just the color of deep, clear water.
But the orange rings are alive. They are mats of heat loving bacteria.
And they change with the seasons. Orange in summer, dark green in winter.
